name: actario
description: Actario keeps the AI conversations you saved elsewhere. Ask where your work stopped, bring a session back, load a memory, read a weekly report, download a deck, or share a masked copy.

interface.longDescription: Actario keeps the AI conversations you save from your computer, masked before they leave it. In ChatGPT you can ask where each line of work stopped, find a session and carry on from it, load a memory, read a line's weekly report, download a deck, and share a masked copy. Saving a conversation happens on a computer with the Actario plugin, not here.
